subject: Pilot briefing — move to post-budget window
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Mendoza <eli.mendoza@novacorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot briefing — move to post-budget window

Eli — thanks again for the slot earlier. A couple of updates from your side would help us lock logistics: you mentioned finance is starting a roll-up / procurement blackout at the end of the month. If that’s the case, we should avoid scheduling the full technical pilot walkthrough during that window so procurement doesn’t have to chase deliverables while they’re closed.

Proposed options:
- Move the live 45–60m pilot briefing to the week of May 27 (after your roll-up)
- Or run a condensed 25m executive demo on May 24–25 and follow up with a recorded deep-dive for the engineers

I’ve attached a one-pager and a condensed agenda (draft) to help frame both options. If procurement needs specific artifacts (SOC2, PO template) ahead of the meeting, please flag and I’ll get our ops team to push them over.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: condensed-agenda-20260519.pdf (1 page)

Subject: Re: Pilot briefing — move to post-budget window

Marissa — thanks for the heads up and the materials. Quick update from my side: our CFO is traveling May 23–26 for a board roll-up and procurement is entering a short blackout starting May 24 as we close the month. That rules out the longer technical pilot in that window.

Two asks:
1) Can you hold any live, PO-relevant discussions until after May 26?
2) If you can offer a 20–30 minute executive demo that’s non-PO-specific on May 24 or 25, that would be useful for our product leadership who will still be available.

Procurement also wants the SOC2 snapshot and a PO template in advance — I’ve copied procurement on this thread. They’ll follow up with a short list.

—Eli
Eli Mendoza
Senior Product Manager, NovaCorp
eli.mendoza@novacorp.com

Eli — thanks for the clarity. We can do either option; to keep momentum I recommend the executive 25–30m demo now (non-procurement), then schedule the full 60m technical pilot the week of May 31 / June 1 once your blackout ends. That keeps leadership engaged and gives procurement time to review documents without pressure.

If that works I’ll:
- Put a 25m slot on May 25 as a placeholder (for product leadership only)
- Tentatively book a full pilot for Tue, June 1 at 10:00 AM PT (can move if that collides with anything)
- Share a short recorder link and the Mutual Action Plan in Drive so your team and procurement can start reviewing the ask items asynchronously

Attachment: condensed-agenda-20260519.pdf (updated)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1MUTUALACTIONPLAN

Cc’ing Lauren and Rishi — Lauren, can Sales Ops prepare a PO-friendly quote and hold terms in DocuSign for June 1? Rishi, can your team surface SOC2 snapshot and retention policy docs for procurement?

Thanks,
